questions.q: A finance team's analysts need to see aggregate revenue but never individual customers' names on transaction rows, all from the same table other teams also query. What's the right fix?
options: A column mask on the customer-name column, scoped to a group that excludes general analysts
A second catalog that duplicates the data with names removed
Deleting the customer-name column entirely for everyone
Granting every analyst full unrestricted access and trusting them
questions.explain: A column mask keeps one source of truth while showing different views by role — no duplicated, drifting copy of the data.

questions.q: A pipeline ingests millions of new files per day across thousands of subdirectories, and directory listing on every run is timing out. What should it use instead?
options: Auto Loader's file notification mode
A larger cluster with more directory-listing threads
A nightly full re-scan of the entire folder tree
Switching from Parquet to CSV
questions.explain: File notification mode subscribes to cloud storage events instead of listing the directory tree on every run, which is what breaks down at high file counts.

questions.q: A silver-layer Lakeflow table must drop any row with a negative order_total but keep the pipeline running rather than failing the whole update. Which expectation action fits?
options: expect_or_drop
expect_or_fail
A CHECK constraint that halts the cluster
Deleting the column so it can never be negative
questions.explain: expect_or_drop filters out violating rows without stopping the pipeline; expect_or_fail would halt the entire run instead.

questions.q: A multi-task job has Task A feeding two independent tasks, B and C, which both must finish before Task D runs. How should Task D's dependencies be configured?
options: Task D depends on both Task B and Task C
Task D depends only on Task A
Tasks B, C, and D must all run in one single task
Task D should run before B and C to save time
questions.explain: Databricks Jobs support dependency graphs, not just linear chains — a task can wait on multiple upstream tasks finishing in parallel.

questions.q: A join between a large fact table and a small dimension table runs fast on most partitions but very slowly on a handful of them. What's the most likely cause and fix?
options: Data skew, addressed by Adaptive Query Execution splitting the skewed partitions
Insufficient disk space, fixed by adding more storage
A missing index, fixed by rebuilding the table from scratch
The join syntax is invalid and should error instead of running slowly
questions.explain: A small number of disproportionately large partitions is the classic data-skew pattern; AQE can detect and split them automatically.

questions.q: A pipeline needs a database password to connect to an on-prem source, without hard-coding it where other notebook users could read it. What's the right approach?
options: Store it in a secret scope and retrieve it at runtime with dbutils.secrets.get()
Paste the password directly into a notebook cell as a comment
Email the password to every team member who needs it
Store it in a public Unity Catalog table
questions.explain: Secrets management resolves the real value only at runtime and never displays it in notebook output or history.

questions.q: What is the actual skill DP-750's scenario-style questions are testing, according to this lesson?
options: Recognizing which feature's real constraints match the situation described, not just recalling a feature's name
Memorizing every menu item in the Databricks UI by heart
Typing speed under a strict time limit
Guessing based on which answer option is the longest
questions.explain: Every scenario in this lesson followed the same shape: a constraint rules out the obvious-sounding wrong answer, leaving one feature that actually fits.

questions.q: In the Unity Catalog governance scenario, why is a second, masked-data catalog the wrong instinct compared to a column mask?
options: It duplicates storage and can drift out of sync with the original table over time
Creating a second catalog is technically impossible in Unity Catalog
Column masks are being deprecated in favor of duplicate catalogs
There is no meaningful difference between the two approaches
questions.explain: A column mask keeps a single source of truth; a duplicated catalog creates a second copy of the data that must be kept in sync manually.
